newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: PdVSA third marginal field auction details.
newsitem.headline: PdVSA third marginal field auction details.

text.p: Venezuelan state-owned oil company PdVSA will put on a roadshow in early November offering twenty marginal fields as part of their third round of auctioning operating concessions, official sources told Reuters.

Of the fields on offer, five will be reserved for Venezuelan companies as part of a strategy to promote local investment in the oil industry. Nine are in eastern Venezuela and 11 in Western Venezuela. Production ranges from zero to 13,000 barrels per day.

The fields are: Intercampo N; Bachaquero S.O; Cretacico S; Mene Grande; La Concepcion; Ambrosio; Cabimas; LL-652; B- 2X.68/79; B-2-X.70/80; La Vela Costa Afuera; Mata; Caracoles; Maulpa; Kaki; Dacion; Onado; Boqueron; Acema; Casma y Anaco.
Further details will be formally released on Tuesday, October 29 by the Ministry of Energy and Mines.
PdVSA estimates that in ten years total operating contracts will generate some 500,000 bpd of the nearly five million bpd the company expects to produce.
